newsitem.title: USA: TCW Convertible sets special distribution.
newsitem.headline: TCW Convertible sets special distribution.

text.p: TCW Convertible Securities Fund Inc said on Monday its board of directors set a special distribution representing the fund's additional income and capital gains.
The distribution is in addition to a regular distribution of $0.21 per share previously announced to be paid to shareholders of record on December 31 1996.

The amount for the special distribution, to be paid to shareholders of record on January 3 1997, will be determined once the results of operations have been calculated based on the fund's trading activity through the remainder of the year.
The preliminary estimate for the special distribution is about $0.14 per share.
The distribution will ensure that at least 98 percent of all taxable net investment income and net capital gain realized by the fund during 1996 is distributed to shareholders.
TCW Convertible is a close-end Fund which began operations in March 1987 and currently has net assets of approximately $275 million.
